name: Garden of Plenty 300%
description: During the event, challenge Calyx (Golden) and Calyx (Crimson) successfully to receive triple rewards.
introduction:
◆ Event Rules ◆
During the event, challenge and complete Calyx (Golden) and Calyx (Crimson) to receive triple rewards.
You will get two additional sets of rewards on top of default drops after consuming an event triple reward opportunity and Trailblaze Power.
During the event, the number of triple reward opportunities is limited. The limits and attempts used so far can be viewed on the Garden of Plenty 300% event page.
The triple reward count will not reset during the event. Be sure to schedule your time for this challenge accordingly, Trailblazers.
If the triple reward from both the Starlit Homecoming and Garden of Plenty 300% events are active simultaneously, the Garden of Plenty 300% event count will be prioritized for consumption when claiming rewards that fit the conditions for both events.

◆ Event Rewards ◆
By completing Calyx (Golden) and Calyx (Crimson) and obtaining EXP Materials, credits, and Trace Materials, players will automatically consume an attempt to receive triple rewards.
